metadata.value: ML2 is a Computer-Aided Software Engineering (CASE) tool, based on the Model-Driven Software Engineering (MDSE) paradigm, specifically the Domain-Specific Modeling (DSM) methodology with full code generation. ML2 is focused on creating smart services for the Internet of Things (IoT) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS).
